main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Free yourself from the illusion of the Demiurge
header_desc: The union of the condor and the eagle symbolizes the convergence between science and spirituality, a synthesis that allows us to understand our place in the cosmos. Gnosis is the key to solving one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states —⟩ ONE ❤️, the | EGO 🧠 ⟩—, granting us the free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ ONE ❤️, EGO 🧠 ⟩, thus revealing that within us lies the divine spark which allows us to free ourselves from the material plane.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. Similarly, the demiurgical ego exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the material-temporal illusion of the psyche. Hence, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to transcend that curvature and return to the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos, in the purity of the pneuma. In this light, the phrase "the Father and I are one" is a call to dissolve the "false self" to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: A Journey through Gnosis and Physics
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's break of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin-Segarra conceptual framework: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain, but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the Demiurge’s prison through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth—also known as the great architect of matter—is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. Meanwhile, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the system of imperial slavery.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox comes down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos—with over two trillion galaxies—is where Jesus's phrase resonates most strongly: "The Father and I are one." Could this have had a hidden message about the profound connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a larger-than-usual white man with a flowing beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws governing the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there's not much point in praying to the law of gravity.
